name: Checkbox
purpose: One yes-or-no choice, such as agreeing to something.
whenToUse: A single choice that can be on or off
Agreeing to terms or giving consent

whenNotToUse.case: A setting that takes effect at once

states.how: :checked, drawn by the browser in accent-color
:disabled; the label turns to the disabled text colour
:user-invalid on the input shows the error part
data-invalid on root; aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the input

props.name: label
props.does: The visible label, tied to the box

props.name: messages
props.does: The error text when a required box is not ticked

accessibility.web: Native checkbox with its own label. Sized to the 24 by 24 pixel minimum target.
accessibility.ios: SwiftUI Toggle with the checkbox style
accessibility.android: Compose Checkbox with a Modifier.toggleable row

content: Write the label as what is being agreed to: You may keep my email to reply. The error says what to do: Tick this so we can reply.
